txt: Blood gushes from the helmet's eye-sockets as Ruud staggers back, disoriented. The sounds coming from his helmet are not human.
The man tilts his head, trying to see through the clearing smoke -- for the *next* shot.
To your right, the killer raises his rifle and takes aim at you. His moves are steady, but the long barrel of the rifle sways slowly...
With a wordless gurgle, the killer loads his long rifle...
You stare down the barrel of the gun. You see Ruud's mask behind it -- his eye in the slit of the helmet. Like a camera lens focusing on you.
"... all of you fucking cunts inside out..."
"... in your shit-pipes, right..." Indecipherable mumbling.
"...*PIGFUCK!*" The voice from beneath the helmet interrupts your thoughts. You only make out the last word.
"...*PIGFUCK!*" is the only word you can make out. It doesn't sound calm.
"...*PIGFUCK!*" is the only word you can make out.
"Peaceful..." It sounds like the armoured figure is weeping.
